purpose: The declared internal-operations flow estate: every endpoint contract key, the physical Power Automate flow behind it, its workflow id where the corpus records one, and the definition file in this repository that covers it. scripts/flow-list-sweep.mjs reads this to state contract coverage; it never infers an attribution from a filename.
whyItMatters: The full-scope provisioning gate is held open by "Internal operations — 7 of ~20 flow definitions available". That count is of CONTRACT KEYS. Several keys share one physical flow, so the number of flows that actually have to be exported is smaller than the number of keys — this register is where that arithmetic is visible rather than assumed.
credentialPolicy: Workflow ids only. A signed trigger URL is a bearer credential and its sig token is never recorded here, in line with scripts/flow-inventory.mjs.

contractKeys.note: SERVICEABLE. IP_Reference_Data_Endpoint, 51 packaged actions to 51 live. INSTALLED AND VERIFIED IN THE TENANT 2026-09-04. The flow was rebuilt not by pasting but by scripts/patch-flow-package.mjs --install, which writes the declarations and the scope into the flow's own exported definition and is imported with Update. Re-exported afterwards, it reads 0 missing, 0 different, 0 extra against its package, every variable write carrying its value, every connector host in the definition shape, the eight declarations at the top level, and Method = POST. The flow id is unchanged, so the trigger URL is unchanged. 13 variable writes, 7 connector actions. The deployed config still points this key at d67f2acb3708449490eed561ee56efbe, so the cutover is the remaining step. The rejected candidate, Fetch_Users_Categories_Departments_Data_Sync, is hand-built and unchanged. CLOSED: the question of whether two flows shared the display name Fetch_Users_Categories_Departments_Data_Sync is moot. That flow is not this key's flow and no contract key points at it, so which of it exists changes nothing this register asserts.

It was emptied on 2026-09-03 when the key was genuinely unbuilt, and carries a real definition for the first time on 2026-09-04.

changelog.what: Attributed every physical flow to a definition exported from the live tenant on 2026-08-19. All 16 flows and all 20 contract keys are now covered by a deployed definition rather than by a capture, an inference or nothing. Where more than one deployed flow carries the right shape, every candidate is attributed so the footprint is a union rather than a guess, and the note says whether the ambiguity can affect the gate.

Read workflow_identity out of the definitions themselves. That confirmed REFERENCE_DATA and DYNAMIC_GLOBAL_ACTIONS, settled the EMAIL_RELATED_TASK conflict, supplied both OTP ids that no labelled register held, and opened a new conflict on BULK_ASSIGNMENT. Two definitions were also recovered from deleted git history: Dynamic_Multi-Actions (closes four contract keys) and a copy of the fetch-all flow.

Consolidation of the five most recently updated branches. SCAN_INTAKE takes the claude/system-remediation-gaps-ahpmsy row (IP_SCAN_INTAKE 5504d7f9-cc96-470c-be79-217582faf415, tenant export attached, checked by npm run test:keyimpl); the superseded ECM_DOCS_INTAKE attribution is not restored. Every other key keeps the claude/fetchall-flow-error-1h94u5 tenant-sourced ids. The OTP rows keep the claude/sharepoint-lists-gap-bqo7j7 two-flow model, so physicalFlows returns to 16.

changelog.what: Every contract key names the one adopted definition (registers/flow-adoption.json) and nothing else. The duplicate and superseded definitions the earlier versions listed are retired and removed (registers/flow-retirement.json records each, with its hash and last commit). Workflow ids are the trigger ids in registers/endpoint-register.json current_configuration. BULK_ASSIGNMENT_DIRECT is retired: no definition.

BULK_ASSIGNMENT_DIRECT removed from the Folio configuration (owner, 2026-10-06): its contract-key row and its physical-flow row are deleted. Bulk assignment is BULK_ASSIGNMENT. The retirement is recorded in registers/flow-adoption.json (retiredContractKeys) and registers/endpoint-register.json (retired_configuration).

USER_ADMIN added (owner approval 2026-10-08, ITEM-25): Folio's User Administration on its own flow, IP_User_Admin_Endpoint (e3e5c825), created from IP_Dynamic_Global_Actions_Endpoint with only the user-admin operation, because DYNAMIC_ACTIONS has no room under the service's 500-action limit.

ACTIVITY_LIFECYCLE added (owner decision 2026-10-10, ITEM-25): Folio's Activities lifecycle (Archive, SIWES, NYSC) on its own flow, IP_Activity_Lifecycle_Endpoint (b4db02d8), created from IP_Dynamic_Global_Actions_Endpoint with only the lifecycle, because DYNAMIC_ACTIONS has no room under the service's 500-action limit.
